verdict.rationale: Slack documents connecting AI agents such as ChatGPT, Claude and Codex into chats as teammates. It also documents an Events API for bots that respond to Slack activity and an 'Create an agent' path. The pack never explicitly shows adding an agent to a channel as a member or the agent replying when @mentioned. missing for 10: explicit docs on adding an agent or bot user to a channel, mention-triggered responses, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: Easily connect agents, software, and all your apps in just a few clicks, and start using tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Asana right within your chats.
our goal is to turn Codex into a teammate. The most natural place for that is Slack.
Coding agents can now work with your whole team, not just you.
The Events API is a streamlined way to build apps and bots that respond to activities in Slack.
